column1: # The corrections rhc reads the Haskell 2010 Report with, and what this library does with each (D38 of
# docs/plans/language/haskell2010.md, the haskell2010 roadmap, with the owner's answer of 2026-11-24). No errata to
# the 2010 Report were ever published. Its sources (github.com/haskell/haskell-report) hold five commits after the
# text of 2010-07-20 (15bff26, which pristine/ is taken from) that change what a reader sees: the owner had 2010's
# text read with the four that change the text, as 98's errata are read into 98's; the fifth changes the printed
# index alone. And 98's eighteen published errata, where 2010's text is 98's word for word and lacks them, are read
# into it too (D38 (a)(i), N18). A correction that changes the Report's code is applied in the modules of this
# directory and is an entry of overlay.tsv; every other one is about prose, the grammar or an index, and the column
# where says what rhc does with it. The 2010 conformance table (the roadmap's M1) holds each one's rows.
# Columns: id; date; source (the sources' commit, or 98's errata page,
# kind (code, prose, grammar, index); in2010 (whether the published text has it: html and pdf, pdf only, no; for
# 98's errata, absorbed, absorbed in effect, not absorbed, moot, not applicable); here (applied: an entry of
# overlay.tsv; carried: in 98's code that a module of this directory carries, provenance.tsv; none); where.
